caption: Someone asks about evening classes and prices, and gets answers from the studio’s own timetable and price list
A trial seat is checked and booked, with the time and what to bring
A health question gets a fixed reply before any AI runs: a coach calls first, no advice given
After class, the coach marks who came. The system never guesses
A thank-you for whoever came, one try-again invite for whoever did not, and a nudge to the coach for anyone not marked
